name: pairwire
description: An experimental browser-based peer-to-peer messaging app built with WebRTC.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs
scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.check: npm run hygiene:check && npm run typecheck && npm test
